title: SSRS report with a UI builder (uiBuilder=true scaffold) + custom filtered lookup on a contract parameter via bindInfo/registerOverrideMethod
instruction: In the sandbox model, use generate_object(mode="scaffold", objectType="report", name="DemoCustGroupReport", caption="@TaxTransactionInquiry:HeaderNote", fieldsHint="GroupId, Description", contractParams=[{name:"custGroup", type:"str", label:"@TaxTransactionInquiry:HeaderNote"}], uiBuilder=true, generateController=true) to scaffold a 7-object SSRS report: a TempDB tmp table, a DataContract carrying the custGroup parameter, a DemoCustGroupReportUIBuilder class extending SrsReportDataContractUIBuilder and bound on the contract via [SysOperationContractProcessing(classStr(DemoCustGroupReportUIBuilder))], a Data Provider, a Controller, an output menu item, and the AxReport. The scaffolded build() in the UI builder is a TODO stub -- replace it with a real filtered lookup for the custGroup parameter: after super(), fetch the contract instance via this.dataContractObject(), get its dialog field with this.bindInfo().getDialogField(contract, methodStr(DemoCustGroupReportContract, parmCustGroup)), and call registerOverrideMethod(methodStr(FormStringControl, lookup), methodStr(DemoCustGroupReportUIBuilder, custGroupLookup), this). Implement custGroupLookup(FormStringControl _ctrl) on the builder using SysTableLookup::newParameters(tableNum(CustGroup), _ctrl): add lookup fields CustGroup and Name, and restrict the lookup query with a range on CustGroup.PaymTermId set to SysQuery::valueNotEmpty() so only customer groups with payment terms appear. Also replace the Data Provider's processReport() TODO stub: insert one tmp row per CustGroup record (GroupId = CustGroup, Description = Name), filtered to contract.parmCustGroup() when it is non-blank, all rows otherwise. All 7 objects must build clean.
